dataset.note: One adult head CT angiogram (0.5 mm isotropic), not an average and not in MNI space. Bone (the cranial bones; the scan cuts the face off): the CT's own surface (400 HU, and thin bone down to 170 HU where it adjoins that bone, outside the labelled vessels, within TotalSegmentator's skull), named bone by bone after the nearest bone of the Z-Anatomy model fitted onto it. Arteries and the deep veins: surfaces of TopBrain's expert labels of the same scan. Cranial nerves, the dural sinuses and arteries TopBrain does not label, the soft tissue and the landmark names: the Z-Anatomy model fitted onto this skull (scaled, then deformed smoothly), so their positions are approximate. Coordinates: millimetres from the fitted hypophysial fossa, the CT turned into the Z-Anatomy model's frame.
